payload.reason: The evidence provides specific methods for evaluating data quality, including the use of BLEU scores and coefficients of variation to assess model output variance and stability across different speakers.

claims.text: The quality of data is evaluated using normalized BLEU scores and coefficients of variation to assess model stability across different speakers.
Quality checks for translations are performed similarly to those for CoVoST, indicating a systematic approach to data evaluation.
Word error rates (WER) and character error rates (CER) are used to evaluate the performance of ASR models, reflecting data quality indirectly.
